vuln.name: Missing Content-Type Header
vuln.description: An HTTP response is missing a Content-Type header, leaving the browser to sniff the content type. This can cause responses to be interpreted as HTML even when not intended.
vuln.impact: Combined with content sniffing this widens the window for XSS and content-confusion attacks.
vuln.recommendation: Always send an explicit, correct Content-Type header, and send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.
